title: MongoDB
summary: Store flexible documents: CRUD, queries, schema design, indexes, aggregation, replication and sharding, and using MongoDB from Python.
outcomes: Explain documents and collections and when MongoDB is the right choice
Create, read, update and delete documents
Query with operators, arrays and nested fields
Design schemas by choosing embed or reference
Speed up queries with indexes and explain()
Summarise data with the aggregation pipeline
Understand transactions, replica sets and sharding
